title: Protein Import into Nucleus, Mitochondria, Plastids and Peroxisomes
method: Unicode lexical counting of 141 actual saved HTML p.teaching-prose elements; excludes headings, SVG, figures, captions, tables, questions and answers, revision, references, UI and source notes. Article total counts student-facing text including expandable answers and visible diagram labels but excludes SVG title/desc and buttons.

comparator.method: Same Unicode lexical method applied to stored previous chapter.

scientific_checks: Verified merged official 2026 Unit 3.C, separate CSIR and archived MP SET Unit 2 transport/organelles and Unit 3 coverage, visually inspected syllabus pages.

Reviewed canonical signal chemistry and positions, NLS/importin α/β, FG nucleoporins, RCC1/RanGAP/NTF2/CAS, CRM1, TOM/TIM23/PAM, mitochondrial alternative pathways, potential direction and processing, TOC/TIC GTP and ATP, SPP, thylakoid Sec/Tat/cpSRP, PTS1/PTS2/Pex5/Pex7, folded cargo and Pex1/Pex6 recycling, ER contrast and exceptions.
Landmark Kalderon et al. 1984, Eilers and Schatz 1986, and Gould et al. 1989 checked against abstracts; additional reviews used for mechanisms and exceptions.

Separate author review corrected destination map, signal placement, Ran cycle, mitochondrial route map and Pex5 extraction topology. Revised nine analytical distractor sets and shuffled non-assertion question options. Added specific references for NFAT, Rubisco assembly and piggyback import.
Recalculated quantitative examples and all seven numerical questions; all hypothetical educational scenarios explicitly identified.

academic_self_review.method: Separate internal author/editor review, not external peer review. Deductions for source access limits, schematic simplification, assessment distractor breadth and lack of interactive browser testing.

limitations: Selected source abstracts and accessible chapters/reviews verified; not all cited full texts read.
MP SET comparison uses archived 2024 public copy, not independently verified current MPPSC-hosted syllabus.
Static HTML and SVG source checks only; independent browser/mobile rendering, full accessibility audit and interactions not exercised.
